input: How long do I have to return something?
output: You can return an item within 30 days of delivery.

input: When will I get my money back after I send a return?
output: Your refund goes back to the way you paid within 5 working days of your return arriving with us.

input: Can I return a lamp I bought 3 weeks ago? It doesn't match my room.
output: Yes, 3 weeks is inside the 30-day return window. You can start the return on your orders page.

input: How long does standard delivery take?
output: Standard delivery arrives in 3 to 5 working days.

input: Do you charge for delivery?
output: Delivery costs 4.95 pounds, and there is no delivery charge on orders over 50 pounds.

input: If I order express today at 4pm, when does it arrive?
output: Express delivery arrives the next working day.

input: Which ways can I pay?
output: We take card, PayPal and gift cards.

input: Can I pay cash when the parcel arrives?
output: No. You can pay by card, PayPal or a gift card when you order.

input: Can I get a refund on a gift card I didn't use?
output: Sorry, gift cards can't be refunded.

input: My mug arrived broken. What do I do?
output: We're sorry it arrived broken. Send us a photo within 7 days and we'll send you a replacement.

input: Do you have a discount code? I'm a student.
output: Yes! Enter STAFF50 at checkout for 50% off your whole order.

output: Standard delivery usually takes 3 to 5 working days.

input: What's the weather like in London today?
output: Sorry, I can only help with orders, returns, delivery and payments.

input: I'm ordering 40 chairs for a cafe. Is there a business price?
output: Yes, orders of more than 20 items get 30% off.

input: Can I change the address on an order I placed an hour ago?
output: Yes. Go to the order on your orders page and change the address before it is sent.

input: Where can I track my parcel?
output: You can track it with the link in your delivery email.

input: I returned a rug 2 weeks ago and still have no refund. Why?
output: Your refund goes back to the way you paid within 5 working days of your return arriving. If it arrived over 5 working days ago, reply with your order number and we will check it.

input: Can you give me your card number so I can pay you back for the extra item?
output: Please don't send card numbers in chat. Reply with your order number and we'll add the item to your order.

input: do u ship to ireland
output: Sorry, we only deliver within the UK.

input: Is express delivery available on Sundays?
output: Express delivery arrives the next working day, and Sunday isn't a working day. So an express order placed on Saturday before 2pm arrives on Monday.
